name: What is the cost of hidden leak detection services?

mainEntity.name: What is the cost of hidden leak detection services?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for hidden leak detection services varies based on the method required and the complexity of the leak. Generally, basic detection starts at a certain service fee, with more advanced techniques like thermal imaging or ground-penetrating radar increasing the cost. It's important to understand that this initial cost covers finding the leak, not the repair itself. We provide transparent pricing after assessing the situation, and the investment in early detection often prevents more expensive water damage repairs down the line. We can provide an estimate after a preliminary assessment of your situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost varies depending on the detection method and leak complexity, covering leak location but not the repair. We provide estimates after assessment.
